zh: 校园卡缺失图片时保留默认图案和不可用提示；普通事项状态更新不会清空仍然有效的媒体错误。保存提示仍优先显示，保存结束后恢复媒体提示。
en: Campus cards retain the default pattern and unavailable-image message when media is missing. Ordinary item state updates no longer clear an active media error. Save status takes priority and the media message returns when saving finishes.
